versions.content: Compatibility of ClassContentConditional Two ClassContentConditional s are considered to be incompatible if • condition is not equivalent OR • elements in attributeTailoring do not match OR • elements in constraintTailoring do not match OR • elements in sdgTailoring do not match Otherwise further analysis is required. See also [TPS_STDT_00131], [TPS_STDT_00133], [TPS_STDT_00134], [TPS_STDT_00209] and [TPS_STDT_00208].
